provenance.note: Validation of pystatistics.gam at 4.8.1 — the gam VA2-F1/VA3-F1 follow-up to the 4.8.0 VA-1 tensor release. 4.8.1 adds the negative-binomial dispersion accessor (GAMSolution.theta / GAMParams.theta, mgcv getTheta) and factor by= smooths (s(x, by=g, by_type='factor'), a smooth per level like mgcv's s(x, by=factor(g))), and makes a categorical-looking by= column with by_type unset fail loud instead of silently fitting a continuous varying coefficient — RESOLVING findings VA3-F1 and VA2-F1 from the 4.8.0 by/nb validation. The whole gam validation set (correctness, tensor, by/nb, performance) is RE-RUN fresh at 4.8.1 to confirm the by/nb fix (which touched the shared _basis/_gam paths) caused no regression. Carried context from 4.8.0: adds te() tensor-product, ti() interaction, and isotropic multivariate s(x,z,...) smooths with per-margin bases and one smoothing parameter per margin, plus the analytic REML/GCV gradient extended to the overlapping penalties these produce. New tensor study (two-tier vs mgcv te()/ti()/s(x,z)): at mgcv's selected sp fed to both engines the tensor BASIS is mgcv-exact — fitted / EDF / coefficients agree to fp64 arithmetic (~1e-16 to ~1e-13 for cr/cc margins, incl. per-margin differing k, mixed cyclic x cubic bs=c('cc','cr'), a Poisson tensor, and a tensor alongside a univariate smooth); under free REML/GCV/UBRE the per-margin sp, per-term & total EDF, deviance, score and fitted match. ti() functional-ANOVA and isotropic s(x,z) are validated by the free-tier estimator (per-term EDF, deviance, REML score, fitted all machine-precision) — their sp REPORTING UNITS differ from mgcv's rescaled m$sp (like the tp basis), so the fixed-sp cross-feed is not attempted for them; the fit is exact. The base univariate surface still matches mgcv (cr/tp plus the A3 cc and ps bases, all machine-precision; R10 hard cases hold; fidelity 6/6 incl. fail-loud on the exotic re/ds/gp/fs bases). Performance: the analytic GCV/REML gradient makes multi-smooth Gaussian fits competitive with mgcv (py/mgcv 0.97x at 1 smooth to 1.84x at 6, IMPROVED from 4.6.1's ~2.0-2.7x; single-smooth 0.86x at n=50000; empirical exponent py<=r, no complexity gap). Estimates unchanged; GLM families keep the finite-difference sp path (their IRLS weights depend on the coefficients). The 4.6.0 first-time validation drove the numerical rewrite that fixed the silently-wrong automatic smoothing selection (H0) and removed the silently-wrong fp32 GPU path (H1); gam is CPU-only. Reference mgcv 1.9.3. Identical float64 inputs to both engines (each case dumps its data to a temp CSV both read). Two-tier contract: fixed-sp tight (exact basis) + free-selection optimizer tier. This artifact ALSO carries the dedicated VA-2 s(x,by=...) and VA-3 family=nb() validation. VA-2 CONTINUOUS by= is mgcv-EXACT: fixed-sp fitted/EDF/coef ~1e-12 (incl. negative and large-magnitude by-columns) and free-REML sp DIRECTLY comparable (≤~1e-6, no sp reparameterisation), REML/EDF/deviance/fitted to the optimizer tier. VA-2 FACTOR by= (by_type='factor', new at 4.8.1) builds a smooth per level matching mgcv s(x,by=factor(g))+factor(g): same coefficient count and per-level EDF, total EDF/deviance/fitted to the optimizer tier (~1e-5..1e-7), on both tp and cr bases. VA-3 nb estimated theta — now read from the PUBLIC accessor GAMSolution.theta — agrees with getTheta to ≤~1.3e-5 across moderate/large/small-count regimes, EDF/deviance/fitted matched. Both 4.8.0 findings are RESOLVED at 4.8.1: VA2-F1 (a categorical-looking by= column with by_type unset now fails loud, and factor-by is implemented) and VA3-F1 (theta accessor added). nb+GCV correctly fails loud.

studies.title: G1 correctness — TIER 1 (tight): at mgcv's selected sp, fed to both engines (cr designs)
studies.note: At a SHARED sp the penalized fit is one stable-QR solve, so fitted values / EDF / coefficients / posterior SEs / scale agree to fp64 arithmetic (≤~1e-9, ≤~1e-13 for Gaussian). aic_abs is the documented edf2 df convention difference; smooth_stat_max_rel is the approximate Wood-2013 test — see limitations (widest on the concurvity case).

studies.title: G1 correctness — TIER 2 (optimizer): free selection, each engine picks its own sp — families + R10 + R15
studies.note: R15 default (mcycle), Gaussian/Poisson/Binomial gamSim 4-smooth, and R10 hard cases. sp_rel_nonnull is the max sp disagreement over IDENTIFIED (non-null) cr smooths; null/near-linear terms (λ→∞) are unidentified in sp and compared by EDF instead (next study). n_coef matches mgcv (k−1 per smooth after centering). tp cases compared by fitted/EDF only.

studies.title: G1 — per-smooth sp vs EDF: null/near-linear terms are sp-unidentified (λ→∞) but EDF-matched
studies.note: Identified smooths agree in sp to ~1e-5; near_null=True terms (EDF→1) show a large sp ratio because λ→∞ is only weakly identified — there EDF agrees to ≤1e-4 and the fit is identical. This is correct, not a defect.

studies.title: G2 fidelity — fail-loud, no silent substitution (A6)
studies.note: Unsupported basis/family/method/k and the removed GPU backend all raise rather than silently substituting; wrong-length names raises rather than mislabelling coefficients (H3).

studies.title: G1 TENSOR — TIER 1 (tight): te()/ti()/s(x,z) at mgcv's selected sp, fed to both engines (exact tensor basis)
studies.note: VA-1. At a SHARED per-margin sp the tensor penalized fit is one stable solve, so fitted / coefficients / EDF / scale / AIC agree to fp64 arithmetic across cr, cyclic (cc), per-margin differing k, Poisson, and tensor+univariate models — the tensor product basis is mgcv-exact. ti() and isotropic s(x,z) are NOT in this tier (their sp units differ from mgcv's rescaled m$sp, like tp); they are validated in the free tier.

studies.title: G1 TENSOR — TIER 2 (optimizer): te()/ti()/s(x,z) free REML/GCV/UBRE selection vs mgcv
studies.note: VA-1. Each engine selects its own per-margin sp. The estimator-invariant quantities — per-term & total EDF, deviance, selection score, fitted — match mgcv (fitted ~1e-6..1e-12; EDF ~1e-4..1e-9). sp_max_rel is large only where the sp is weakly identified (cyclic/concurvity: the fit is insensitive to sp) or where ti()/tp sp reporting units differ from mgcv — sp_note flags this, and in every such case EDF and fitted agree, so the fit is correct.

studies.title: VA-2 by= — TIER 1 (tight): s(x, by=z) [continuous] at mgcv's selected sp, fed to both engines
studies.note: At a SHARED sp the by-multiplied cr basis + penalty is one stable-QR solve: fitted / coefficients / total EDF / scale / posterior SE agree to fp64 arithmetic (≤~1e-12), including a by-variable with NEGATIVE values + a zero-variance stretch (by_neg) and a LARGE-magnitude by-column ~1e3 (by_big). The by= basis is mgcv-exact AND its sp is on the same scale as mgcv's — established, not assumed: the identical sp fed to both yields the identical fit.

studies.title: VA-2 by= — TIER 2 (optimizer): s(x, by=z) free REML selection vs mgcv
studies.note: Each engine selects its own sp. For a cr by= smooth the selected sp is DIRECTLY COMPARABLE to mgcv's (sp_rel_max ≤~1e-6 across every case, incl. by_big z~1e3 — there is no sp-scale reparameterisation), the REML score is bit-identical, and total/per-smooth EDF, deviance and fitted match to the optimizer tier (≤~1e-6). by_two exercises s(x,by=z)+s(w) (two penalties).

studies.title: VA-3 nb — free REML: family=nb() estimated dispersion theta + fit vs mgcv nb()
studies.note: theta_r is mgcv's m$family$getTheta(TRUE); theta_py is read from the PUBLIC accessor GAMSolution.theta (added at 4.8.1, VA3-F1 resolved; theta_accessor=yes) and cross-checked against a deviance-inversion recovery. The estimated theta agrees to ≤~1.3e-5 relative across moderate theta, a large theta near the Poisson limit, and small counts; total EDF / deviance / REML score / fitted match to the optimizer tier.

studies.title: VA-2 factor by= — s(x, by=g, by_type='factor') per-level smooths vs mgcv s(x, by=factor(g)) (VA2-F1 fix)
studies.note: New at 4.8.1. A factor by= fits a separate smooth per level of the integer-coded grouping variable (adding the per-level group means), matching mgcv's s(x, by=factor(g)) + factor(g): identical coefficient count and per-level EDF, with total EDF / deviance / REML score / fitted values agreeing to the optimizer tier (~1e-5..1e-7) on both a tp basis (mgcv's factor-by default) and a cr basis. This is the estimator-invariant free-REML comparison (each level carries its own smoothing parameter).

studies.title: VA-2/VA-3 fidelity — the categorical-by guard (VA2-F1) and the nb+GCV fail-loud guard
studies.note: VA2-F1 RESOLVED at 4.8.1: a 3-level factor coded {0,1,2} handed as a by-variable with by_type unset now FAILS LOUD (asking the user to choose by_type='factor' or 'continuous') instead of the pre-4.8.1 silent misinterpretation as a continuous varying coefficient. The nb+GCV path also fails loud (estimated theta needs REML). The factor-by surface itself is validated for agreement in the va2_factor_by study.

studies.title: G3 performance — pystatistics CPU vs mgcv::gam
studies.note: Same estimator (penalised spline + GCV), CPU-vs-CPU vs mgcv's compiled C, best-of-5. Single smooth: parity across n (py/mgcv ≈1.0–1.8×, 0.97× at n=50000; empirical exponent py=0.43 vs r=0.49). Multi-smooth (Gaussian): the analytic GCV/REML gradient (4.6.1, finding H4) keeps py/mgcv roughly flat across smooth count (~2.0–2.7× at 1→6 smooths) instead of the 4.6.0 climb to ~5.1×; estimates unchanged. GLM families keep the finite-difference path.
